Asymmetrical Bob.description:
💇 Hair Style: Asymmetrical Bob
A bob cut where one side is noticeably longer than the other — sharp, angular, and deliberately uneven.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
